title: Stop Saying "Very Clean"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very clean". Use one of these words instead:
• Spotless: a spotless bathroom
• Immaculate: an immaculate suit
• Pristine: a pristine lake
• Sparkling: sparkling windows
• Gleaming: gleaming white teeth

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
